descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S01 「医院第 2 天：完成今天的记录，在昨天的后面加一条带日期的条目」 Hospital day 2: finishing today's note adds one dated entry after yesterday's

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated.（UAT TC-11；TFA-92589 AC 3）
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.6；TFA-92589 AC 4）
  • U8 Run in both modes for one patient each: Hospital across 2 consecutive days, Nursing Home across 3+ visits.（UAT TC-11；UAT 3.3）
  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note.（TFA-92589 AC 2；TFA-92589 description 1）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Hospital patient whose ledger holds yesterday's entry and today's pre-round line ('⏳ Encounter pending')

When Type the encounter text and tap Generate Note & Finish (model calls mocked at the socket), then open Pre-Round

Then The stored ledger is yesterday's line followed by exactly one line for today carrying the generated entry; the Hospital Course shows both cards, yesterday's first

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in course-timeline.spec.ts: ledger equals '<yesterday line>\n<today>: <entry>' (one line for today, in order), both cards visible, yesterday's text before today's. The model is mocked, so this proves the ledger rules, not the AI entry (S13/S14)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-11.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
